title: JWT subject reinterpreted from userId to email
query: What breaks across repositories if the JWT subject changes from the user UUID to the user email?

affected_repositories.name: account-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns JwtSupport issuance and AddressController UUID.fromString(principal.getSubject())

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: CheckoutController.userId parses principal.getSubject() as UUID for quotes, orders, and lookups

affected_repositories.name: commerce-bff
affected_repositories.evidence_note: SecurityConfig JwtDecoder trust boundary; forwards identity downstream

notes: Security-contract change with no endpoint or schema diff. Every UUID.fromString(getSubject()) throws on an email subject, so authentication succeeds and every authorized call fails: the widest silent breakage in the corpus.
